::: handwriting
**R. P. Tricks for Wickfold. Crew, hands off!**

Key words jumbled, as always, so that nobody spoils a scared face on camera.

- Night 1: blue lamp low behind the presses. Shadows look twice as tall.
- Night 2: park the car in the jumbled street below (4 letters, 4 letters), so the gate mic does not hear it.

{{artifact}}

- Night 3: creaking door from the sound record, track 5. Wait for Fenna's nod.
- Every night: hot coffee for Fenna at ten. A happy crew is a quiet crew.
  :::

::: note
Found under the seat of the van on 22 December. R. jumbles the key word of each trick, so that we never know it until the cameras roll. The eight letters under Night 2 make the name of a street in Wickfold, two words of four letters each. F. O.
:::
